title: Microscope Lab
objectives: Prepare a thin sample to view cells

stages.title: The Decay Spreads
stages.narration: Lord Necrosis is dissolving all life. Discover the cell to rebuild the Cell of Life!

steps.text: Lord Necrosis melts living things into goo.
Dr. Cyto: 'The answer lies in the cell.'
Nucleus Bot powers up the microscopes.

stages.title: Parts of a Microscope
stages.prompt: Tap each part to learn its job. Visit them all!

locations.label: Eyepiece
locations.info: The lens you look through at the top.

locations.label: Objective Lens
locations.info: The lens that magnifies the sample the most.

locations.label: Glass Slide
locations.info: Holds the thin sample you want to view.

locations.label: Light Source
locations.info: Shines light up through the thin sample.

stages.title: True or False: Discovery & Tools
stages.prompt: Decide whether each statement is true or false.

tasks.label: He first saw cells in cork
Samples should be very thick
tasks.explain: Samples must be thin so light passes through.

tasks.label: A microscope magnifies tiny objects
tasks.explain: It enlarges small objects like cells.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Reveal the First Cell
stages.prompt: Score 80% to reveal the hidden cell and win the first piece!

questions.q: Why must a sample be thin?
questions.explain: Thin samples give a clear image.

questions.q: The cell is the basic building block of…
questions.explain: All living things are made of cells.

stages.title: Cell of Life: Piece 1 Restored!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Cell Discoverer badge
🧬 Cell of Life: 1 of 8 pieces restored
The first glimmer of life returns!
